functions.label: STERN THRUSTER (rotation/thrust)
functions.what_it_does: Proportionally drives the stern thruster's directional actuator toward STBD or PORT depending on a 0-10V analog command, with the spool resting open-center at no-signal so pump flow free-circulates to tank when the thruster is idle.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool 157B7123 sits open-neutral: pressure rail P flows straight through the open spool center to tank return T; A and B work ports are not pressurised; LS lines relax to tank via the LS_A/LS_B limiter cartridges (both set to 250 bar).

PVEU pilot module shifts spool so P feeds work port A, routed off-sheet to the STBD-side thruster actuator; return oil comes back on port B through the spool to T; LS signal is taken from the A-side path, capped at 250 bar by the LS_A limiter cartridge.

PVEU pilot module shifts spool the other way so P feeds work port B, routed off-sheet to the PORT-side thruster actuator; return oil comes back on port A through the spool to T; LS signal is taken from the B-side path, capped at 250 bar by the LS_B limiter cartridge.
If A-port load pressure exceeds 280 bar, the A work-port relief cartridge opens and dumps A-port oil to the common P/T rail, protecting the STBD actuator/hose.
If B-port load pressure exceeds 280 bar, the B work-port relief cartridge opens and dumps B-port oil to the common P/T rail, protecting the PORT actuator/hose.

key_components: PVEU proportional pilot module — directs the main spool per 0-10V signal
Main directional proportional spool (open-neutral center) — part 157B7123
Work-port relief, A side — set 280 bar (part 157B2280)
Work-port relief, B side — set 280 bar (part 157B2280)
LS limiter cartridge, A side — set 250 bar (per engineer pressure_settings fact)
LS limiter cartridge, B side — set 250 bar (per engineer pressure_settings fact)
functions.dry_data: PVG 32 module, spool 65 l/min, PVEU 0-10V proportional actuation, <5V=A(STBD)/>5V=B(PORT), open-neutral position

functions.label: S.T. UP/DOWN (thruster lift)
functions.what_it_does: On/off drive that raises (UP) or lowers (DOWN) the stern thruster unit into or out of its housing; spool is closed-center at rest so the thruster stays locked in position with no command.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool closed-center: P is blocked, both A and B work ports isolated — thruster lift actuator holds its current up/down position with no flow either way.

PVEO pilot module shifts spool so P feeds work port A (UP), driving the lift actuator upward; return oil from the opposite side returns via the spool to the common T rail; load-sensing pressure relief on this circuit limits to 100 bar.

PVEO pilot module shifts spool the other way so P feeds work port B (DOWN), driving the lift actuator downward; return oil comes back through the spool to T; load-sensing pressure relief limits to 100 bar.

key_components: PVEO ON/OFF pilot module — solenoid-actuated pilot stage on top of main spool
Load-sensing pressure relief — set 100 bar (per engineer pressure_settings fact)
functions.dry_data: PVG 16 module, spool 5 l/min, PVEO ON/OFF actuation, UP=A / DOWN=B, closed-neutral position

functions.label: S.T. LOCK (thruster lock)
functions.what_it_does: On/off drive that locks (IN) or unlocks (OUT) the stern thruster's mechanical lock, securing the unit once positioned by the S.T. UP/DOWN function; closed-center at rest so the lock holds its state without continuous flow.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool closed-center: P blocked, both A (IN) and B (OUT) work ports isolated — lock actuator holds its last commanded state.

PVEO pilot module shifts spool so P feeds work port A (IN), driving the lock actuator to engage; return oil comes back via the spool to T; load-sensing pressure relief on this circuit limits to 70 bar.

PVEO pilot module shifts spool the other way so P feeds work port B (OUT), driving the lock actuator to disengage; return oil comes back via the spool to T; load-sensing pressure relief limits to 70 bar.

key_components: Load-sensing pressure relief — set 70 bar (per engineer pressure_settings fact)
functions.dry_data: PVG 16 module, spool 5 l/min, PVEO ON/OFF actuation, IN=A / OUT=B, closed-neutral position

infrastructure.system_name: Danfoss PVG 32/16 AFT block B manifold
facts: Common rails run along the sheet bottom: P (pressure inlet), T (tank return), M (measurement/gauge port), LS (load-sense), LS_A and LS_B (load-sense A/B taps) — shared by all three stern-thruster function slices.

Inlet section (bottom-left, part 11166832/157B5111 area) hosts the block-level standalone pressure valve; per engineer convention this reduced-pressure valve supplies SPOOL CONTROL (pilot) pressure to the slices.

Block main relief present in the inlet section, protecting the whole AFT block B manifold (per engineer block_relief convention: inlet-section relief = main block pressure relief, in bar); numeric value not legible on this crop.

Red warning triangles appear at several valve positions on EV-9.1/EV-9.2/EV-9.3 — these are revision markers tied to rev.10 row 'PROPORTIONAL AFT WINCHES' per the sheet's own revision table, not unidentified components.

uncertainties: Exact bar value of the standalone block-inlet pressure-reducing/relief valve near the M/LS rails is not legibly printed in this crop.

Part numbers on several internal check/shuttle symbols (e.g. small diamond checks under the pilot modules) are present but too small to confirm at this resolution; function is understood (LS signal shuttle/check network) even though the exact part ID is unconfirmed.

The routing of hoses from EV-9.1's A/B work ports off-sheet to the STBD/PORT thruster actuator halves is per the printed A/B legend mapping (TO STBD <5V=A / TO PORT >5V=B); the physical hose destination beyond the sheet edge is not itself drawn, so it is taken from the legend, not traced pixel-by-pixel.
